interface.longDescription: TavernWeave 1.7.0, 22 skills. Provides specifications and scenarios for Agents to build optional project-specific frontend sandboxes from maintained source: single or joint modules, explicit test-data confirmation, state comparison and manual UI tuning. Reuse the project stack and preview service. Work libraries, plain language and user-selected guidance remain available. Sandbox evidence does not replace real-host or driver acceptance.
